scientific_integrity: The Poisson–Lindley model is credited to its original authors and the lattice compound-Poisson characterization to established literature. The exact new phase comparison has been checked algebraically and by a separate exact-arithmetic script; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies real-valued ordinary infinite divisibility and distinguishes convolution roots constrained to nonnegative integers; it does not classify thinning self-decomposability, multivariate extensions or inference behavior. Earlier inaccessible literature leaves historical-priority risk. Analytic infinite-degree arguments are not inferred from finite tests.
title: A disconnected infinite-divisibility phase diagram for zero-modified Poisson–Lindley counts
